falseSynonyms.zh: 同工同酬不等於 gender pay gap equal pay 通常指相同或相若工作應獲得相同薪酬的原則；gender pay gap 是群體層面的平均或整體薪酬差異。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A workplace can have an equal pay policy and still report a gender pay gap across the organisation.

falseSynonyms.zh: 薪酬歧視不等於所有 gender pay gap pay discrimination 指因性別等因素而對個別僱員給予不公平薪酬待遇；gender pay gap 本身只描述群體差距，不能單憑差距判定其成因。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Pay discrimination concerns unequal treatment, while the gender pay gap is a broader statistical difference.

falseSynonyms.zh: 薪金差異不一定涉及性別 salary difference 只表示兩份薪金不同，原因可以是職位、資歷、工時或其他因素。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A salary difference between two employees is not automatically a gender pay gap.

falseSynonyms.zh: 工資不平等範圍更廣 wage inequality 可以指不同職業、地區、收入組別或社會群體之間的工資差距，不限性別。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Wage inequality is a broader concept than the gender pay gap.

falseSynonyms.zh: 收入不平等不等於性別薪酬差距 income inequality 通常指整個社會或人口中的收入分配差異，範圍比 gender pay gap 大得多。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A country may experience high income inequality for reasons unrelated to gender.

falseSynonyms.zh: 薪酬公平不等於薪酬差距 pay equity 是公平制定薪酬的原則或目標，不是用來直接命名一個統計差距。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The organisation introduced a pay equity review after analysing its gender pay gap.

falseSynonyms.zh: 薪酬和工資語意範圍不同 pay 是較廣泛的薪酬概念；wage 常指按時、日或週計算的工資，但在統計語境中也常泛指勞動報酬。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The report compares both hourly wages and total annual pay.

falseSynonyms.word: Gender pay gap / gender pay gaps
falseSynonyms.zh: 單數和複數不同 單數通常指一個整體差距；複數可指不同地區、行業或群體中的多個差距。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The national gender pay gap narrowed. The report compares gender pay gaps across industries.
